Fourth development release of 0.18.0: fixes for the bugs reported against dev3, and steadier stale checks.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.18.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.18.0 right.

Everything in [0.18.0-dev1](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev1), [0.18.0-dev2](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev2) and [0.18.0-dev3](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev3) is included; read their notes for the full list.

### Fixed

- #402 - **MAC tables are read on Cisco switches with no IP in VLAN 1:** the switch's own VLANs are read first, and VLANs a VTP domain lists but the switch has no port in are skipped instead of ending the read. MACs that leave such a switch are now marked gone. **Poll now** doesn't read per-VLAN tables; a scheduled poll or **Refresh MACs** does.
- #403, #404, #407 - **Moving a rack checks cabinet-mounted bay children, split stacks and site-local tags, VRFs and roles on components, and names only objects you may see.**
- #405, #406 - **A proposed Oxidized link no longer keeps a node from its confirmed device,** and after the upgrade nodes Danbyte hasn't seen yet are proposed rather than linked. A connection's first sync after the upgrade may propose nodes that appeared since its last sync.
- **A stale check stays stale until the address comes back up,** instead of dropping back to down after a single answer or a fast-probe pass.

Thank you @jorge-madrigal and @deku-m for the reports.
